translations.EN: The listener gives a small acknowledging nod.

translations.EN: The listener's shoulders relax with affectionate recognition.

translations.EN: The listener nods warmly, visibly moved by the memory.

translations.EN: A momentary pause, nothing more.

translations.EN: The listener gives nothing away, nodding once carefully.
translations.TL: Walang ipinakitang emosyon ang nakikinig, isang maingat na tango lang.
